role_feature_congenital_intro1001.ch: 你从小身强体壮，骨骼惊奇。强大的体魄与坚硬的骨骼让你从未受过重伤，长期的锻炼也让你的身体越来越强。
role_feature_congenital_intro1001.en: You were born with a remarkable physique. Blessed with strong muscles and unbreakable bones, you were never heavily injured. Your workout habit has only made you even stronger over time.

role_feature_congenital_intro1002.ch: 从小你就没有办法控制好自己的灵力。时不时就喷涌而出需要进行压制的感觉都在告诉你，你身体中的能量异于常人。
role_feature_congenital_intro1002.en: Since childhood, you have been unable to control your spiritual power well. It often surges out and needs to be suppressed. This feeling tells you that the energy in your body is different from ordinary people.

role_feature_congenital_intro1003.ch: 你差点就认为世界上除了你自己，所有人都是瞎子。你能看到常人所不能看到的细节，你能够看到隔壁小镇酒馆砖墙上的蚂蚁窝，也能够看清天空中燕雀的发型。在战斗中，你更容易看清敌人的弱点。
role_feature_congenital_intro1003.en: You almost thought that everyone in the world except you was blind. You can see details that ordinary people cannot see. You can see the ant nest on the brick wall of the tavern in the neighboring town, and even see the hairstyle of a sparrow in the sky. In battle, you are more easily able to see the weaknesses of enemies.

role_feature_congenital_intro1004.ch: 你对于移动的方式有着自己独特的理解，你永远都能够快人一步到达目的地，最速之人的名号在你的家乡无人不知无人不晓。
role_feature_congenital_intro1004.en: You have your own unique Insight of movement. You always manage to reach the destination before others. The title of the fastest person is well-known in your hometown.

role_feature_congenital_intro1005.ch: 你的面容受到过破坏，只能呈现微笑，这使得你受人污辱，像小丑一样被人“欢迎”但你仍然坚持心中的正义
role_feature_congenital_intro1005.en: Your face was wounded in an accident. Now, the only expression on your face is a smile. People laugh at you for it and treat you like a clown. But none of that ever stopped you from doing the right thing.

role_feature_congenital_intro1006.ch: 你生的眉清目秀、丽质天成，无论走到什么地方都是人们关注的焦点。加上你性情温柔，举止优雅，深受所有人的喜爱。
role_feature_congenital_intro1006.en: With your beautiful appearance and natural grace, you always attract people's attention wherever you go. Combined with your gentle and elegant manner, you are loved by everyone.

role_feature_congenital_intro1101.ch: 一直以来你养成了一个习惯，遇到什么事情都不会慌张。这种泰山崩于前，而面不改色的气质，让你在村里倍受好评。
role_feature_congenital_intro1101.en: You have always developed a habit of not panicking in any situation. Your calmness in the face of crisis has earned you high praise in the village.

role_feature_congenital_intro1102.ch: 你小时候，在村口酒楼吃上一口茴香豆，从那以后你就再也忘不了那种味道。口袋里总是少不了一把茴香豆，并且逢人就问茴香豆的茴字有几种写法。
role_feature_congenital_intro1102.en: When you were little, you had a chance to have a broad bean snack. Since then, its anise flavor has stuck in your head. You love it so much that wherever you go now, you keep some beans in your pocket.

role_feature_congenital_intro1103.ch: 你的家族一直都很长寿，你的奶奶居然活到了150多岁，被当地人传为佳话。或许是这个原因，你从小就很强壮，不怎么生病。
role_feature_congenital_intro1103.en: Your family has always been long-lived, with your grandmother living to over 150 years old, which has become a local legend. Perhaps because of this, you have been strong and rarely get sick since childhood.

role_feature_congenital_intro1104.ch: 你从出生时便患有先天顽疾，大夫断你绝活不过30岁。你常年体弱多病，但你天资过人，无论学习什么都能够轻易的融会贯通。
role_feature_congenital_intro1104.en: You were born with a congenital disease and the doctors predicted that you wouldn't live past 30. Despite being constantly ill, you have exceptional intelligence and can easily master anything you learn.

role_feature_congenital_intro1105.ch: 你出生时父母双亡，方圆十里寸草不生，所有与你亲近的人最后都会身亡，久而久之，周围不再有人与你亲近。你从小仇天恨地，攻击性比较强。在乱世中摸爬滚打，使你下手比别人更狠。
role_feature_congenital_intro1105.en: Both your parents died when you were born, and there was not a blade of grass in a radius of ten li around you. Everyone close to you eventually dies, which has caused people to distance themselves from you. Growing up in such a chaotic world, you became aggressive and your attacks are more ruthless than others'.

role_feature_congenital_intro1106.ch: 你非常喜欢战斗，拥有超越绝大多数人的战斗熟练度，身经百战的你在与战斗中总是能以老辣的经验轻取胜利。
role_feature_congenital_intro1106.en: You love to fight and are highly skilled in combat, surpassing most people. Your experience in countless battles allows you to easily achieve victory.

role_feature_congenital_intro1201.ch: 你的性格比较有攻击性，容易发火，这往往会让别人抓住你言辞上的漏洞进行反击。于是你更加恼怒，变得口不择言。这是一个死循环，但是非常难改。
role_feature_congenital_intro1201.en: Your aggressive nature and quick temper often make others find loopholes in your words and retaliate, which angers you even more and leads to you speaking without thinking. It's a vicious cycle that's hard to break.

role_feature_congenital_intro1202.ch: 你跟着隔壁村的老王学了一手木工活，老王一直教导你，做木工眼要准，手要勤，脑要活，慢工才能出细活。
role_feature_congenital_intro1202.en: You learned woodworking from Wang in the neighboring village. He taught you that a good carpenter must have keen eyes, dexterous hands, quick thinking, and patience.

role_feature_congenital_intro1203.ch: 你曾经和你爷爷学习过如何屠猪。你爷爷说，有了这门技艺，以后不愁饿死。经过几年的实操，你已达到了可以只用一刀就可以放倒一头大肥猪的境界。
role_feature_congenital_intro1203.en: You learned how to slaughter pigs from your grandfather. He said that with this skill, you'll never go hungry. After years of practice, you have reached the level where you can bring down a fat pig with just one stroke of your Blade.

role_feature_congenital_intro1204.ch: 你从来不把任何对手放在眼里，坚信自己天下第一，出手果断且凌厉！这让你浑身都是破绽，并且你的为人也让身边的人对你产生反感。
role_feature_congenital_intro1204.en: You never take any opponents lightly and firmly believe that you are the best, making swift and fierce moves. This exposes your weaknesses, and your behavior allows others to dislike you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1301.ch: 你天生就倔，做事随心所欲，不愿意被约束。这让你从小就挨打，但是依然改不了。干了坏事，你还偷着乐，不管他人感受。
role_feature_congenital_intro1301.en: You are stubborn and do things as you please, unwilling to be restrained. This has caused you to be beaten since you were young, but you still couldn't change. Even after doing something bad, you still derive pleasure from it, disregarding the feelings of others.

role_feature_congenital_intro1302.ch: 不知道是不是受到村里老学究的影响，你为人特别正直，看不惯苟且之人。一切事情，都要谈谈正义与否，这让其它人对你非常友好。
role_feature_congenital_intro1302.en: Perhaps influenced by the old scholar in your village, you grew up to be an upstanding person who would despise anything dishonorable. You always try to do the right thing, and others respect you for that.

role_feature_congenital_intro1303.ch: 你生下来的时候是个黑肉球，差点吓坏了全村人。那天天空乌云密布，电闪雷鸣，闪电击中你家屋顶好几次。五岁时，你就可以举起村口的大石磨，吓死了村长。村里人都不喜欢你，你性格怪癖，对外界的言语根本不关心，你只知道你自己想要什么。
role_feature_congenital_intro1303.en: When you were born, you were a dark ball of flesh that scared the whole village. That day, the sky was full of dark clouds, thunder and lightning, and the lightning struck your house several times. At the age of five, you could lift the village millstone, scaring the village chief. The people in the village didn't like you, as you had a strange personality and didn't care about the words of the outside world. You only knew what you wanted.

role_feature_congenital_intro1304.ch: 小时候你就发现自己和别人不一样，你生得五官端正、一表人才，而且你天生就正义凛然，眼里揉不得沙子，隔壁村的二牛就被你打过好几次，而且每次打架你都发现你不容易受伤。有个算命的说过你是天生道子。
role_feature_congenital_intro1304.en: Since childhood, you realized that you were different from others. You had handsome features and were naturally just and upright, unable to tolerate injustice. You even fought with the neighbor's cow several times, and every time you fought, you found that you were not easily injured. A fortune teller once said that you were born destined for justice.

role_feature_congenital_intro1305.ch: 身经百战的你在战斗中能够非常熟练的去攻击敌人的要害，并且出手十分狠毒。这使得周围的人对你产生畏惧并逐渐远离。
role_feature_congenital_intro1305.en: As someone who has experienced a hundred battles, you are highly skilled in attacking the vital points of your enemies and your moves are ruthless. This makes people around you fear you and gradually distance themselves from you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1401.ch: 你对剑有不一般的领悟力。你的脑海里总能浮现一些莫名其妙的画面，让你凶性大发。你梦中还总能见到一个残影在天空挥剑。
role_feature_congenital_intro1401.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of sword techniques, but many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to hurt people. In your dreams, you often see a blurry shadow waving its sword in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1402.ch: 你对刀有不一般的领悟力。你的脑海里总能浮现一些莫名其妙的画面，让你凶性大发。你梦中还总能见到一个残影在天空挥刀。
role_feature_congenital_intro1402.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of blade techniques, but many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to hurt people. In your dreams, you often see a blurry shadow waving its blade in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1403.ch: 你对枪有不一般的领悟力。你的脑海里总能浮现一些莫名其妙的画面，让你凶性大发。你梦中还总能见到一个残影在天空挥枪。
role_feature_congenital_intro1403.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of spear techniques, but many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to hurt people. In your dreams, you often see a blurry shadow waving its spear in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1404.ch: 你对拳有不一般的领悟力。你的脑海里总能浮现一些莫名其妙的画面，让你凶性大发。你梦中还总能见到一个残影在天空挥拳。
role_feature_congenital_intro1404.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of fist techniques, but many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to hurt people. In your dreams, you often see a blurry shadow waving its fists in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1405.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of finger techniques, but many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to hurt people. In your dreams, you often see a blurry shadow waving its fingers in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1406.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of palm techniques, but many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to hurt people. In your dreams, you often see a blurry shadow waving its palms in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1407.ch: 你对剑有不一般的领悟力。你的脑海里总能浮现一些莫名其妙的画面，让你正义凛然。你梦中还总能见到一个白衣人在天空御剑。
role_feature_congenital_intro1407.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of sword techniques, and many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to help people. In your dreams, you often see a man in white waving his sword in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1408.ch: 你对刀有不一般的领悟力。你的脑海里总能浮现一些莫名其妙的画面，让你正义凛然。你梦中还总能见到一个白衣人在天空御刀。
role_feature_congenital_intro1408.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of blade techniques, and many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to help people. In your dreams, you often see a man in white waving his blade in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1409.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of spear techniques, and many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to help people. In your dreams, you often see a man in white waving his spear in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1410.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of fist techniques, and many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to help people. In your dreams, you often see a man in white waving his fists in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1411.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of finger techniques, and many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to help people. In your dreams, you often see a man in white waving his fingers in the sky.
