role_feature_congenital_intro1412.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of palm techniques, and many inexplicable images that appear in your head make you want to help people. In your dreams, you often see a man in white waving his palms in the sky.

role_feature_congenital_intro1413.ch: 行走于江湖之中的你刀剑不离身。在这人心险恶的世道里，手里的镔铁便是最强硬的护身符。你谨记自己的处世之道，路见不平拔刀相助。也办下过不少善行。
role_feature_congenital_intro1413.en: As you walk in the world, your weapon is always by your side. In this treacherous world, the iron in your hand is the strongest protective talisman. You remember your way of life, drawing your sword to help whenever you see injustice. You have also done many good deeds.

role_feature_congenital_intro1414.ch: 没人知道你的来历，但是都知道你一手枪上功夫了得。常常以一敌多。但是寻常人所不知道的是，你的指劲儿之大也非同小可。有好事人传言你曾练过金刚指的功夫。只可惜见识过你指劲的人，都不曾生还。
role_feature_congenital_intro1414.en: No one knows your origin, but everyone knows that you are skilled in handling firearms. You often fight against multiple opponents. However, what ordinary people don't know is that your finger strength is extraordinary. Some busybodies even spread rumors that you have practiced the skill of Golden Finger. It's just a pity that anyone who has witnessed your finger strength has never survived.

role_feature_congenital_intro1415.ch: 以肉搏之法为人所知的你拳掌功夫颇为了得。曾在喝醉酒后空手打死了一头牛妖，并且凭借一手破桃式常在争斗中占取上风。
role_feature_congenital_intro1415.en: Hand-to-hand combat is your strong suit. One time when you were drunk, you killed a cow monster with your bare hands.

role_feature_congenital_intro1416.ch: 你第一次拿起一把木剑，就舞得呼呼生风。后来你发现，对于剑、刀、枪，都有着特别的领悟力。从此你就有了个决心：潜心悟学武技，以除魔卫道为已任。
role_feature_congenital_intro1416.en: The first time you picked up a wooden sword, you swung it around. Later, you discovered that you had a special Insight of swords, knives, and guns. From then on, you had a determination to immerse yourself in Martial Arts and eliminate evil.

role_feature_congenital_intro1417.ch: 你第一次抡起拳头就把二虎打趴在地，你力大无穷，对于拳法、掌法、指法，都有着特别的领悟力。从此你就有了个决心：要凭自己的力量，走自己的道！
role_feature_congenital_intro1417.en: The first time you ever threw a punch, you knocked out the other guy in an instant. You realized that you had a natural gift in all martial arts involving fists, palms, and fingers. Starting from then, you made up your mind to walk your own path, using your great strength for personal gain.

role_feature_congenital_intro1418.ch: 你从小就喜欢舞刀弄枪，对各种武器、拳脚功夫有着近乎直觉的领悟力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1418.en: Showing a great interest in martial arts at a young age, you have an intuitive comprehension of all kinds of combat techniques.

role_feature_congenital_intro1419.ch: 你的家里一直是开板栗铺的。小时候父亲就一直教你炒板栗，但是贫弱的身子实难支撑你翻炒板栗。长久的翻炒让你手掌力气大了不少，却难以帮助母亲去做些小巧细碎的针线活了。
role_feature_congenital_intro1419.en: Your family has always operated a chestnut shop. When you were young, your father taught you how to stir-fry chestnuts, but your weak body couldn't handle the task. After a long time of stir-frying, you gained strength in your hands, but it became difficult to help your mother with delicate needlework.

role_feature_congenital_intro1420.ch: 打鸟是你的拿手绝活。弹弓一支，眼睛半眯，一颗石子被喂到弹巢里绷紧了皮筋。弹弓声响，鸟便应声而倒。多年的锻炼让你技艺愈发精湛。曾几何时，你就是村里最厉害的打鸟童，无人可出你左右。
role_feature_congenital_intro1420.en: Shooting birds is your passion, and all you need is a slingshot. You were the best amongst all your playmates in your village. No one else even came close. After years of practice, you almost never miss. One stone, one bird.

role_feature_congenital_intro1421.ch: 虽然家里没有钱给你买武功秘籍，你还是期待能像大侠那样仗剑走江湖。你给自己扎了一个大袋子，里面装满沙，挂在横梁上。没事就喜欢砸上几拳。母亲劝你不要伤了身子，但你全当耳旁风。稚嫩的小手竟打出了一层厚实的老茧。
role_feature_congenital_intro1421.en: Although your family didn't have money to buy secret Martial Arts manuals for you, you still hoped to travel the world like a master. You tied a big bag to yourself, filled it with sand, and hung it on the beam. Whenever you had a chance, you liked to hit it a few times. Your mother advised you not to hurt yourself, but you ignored her. Your young hands even developed a thick callus.

role_feature_congenital_intro1422.ch: 每当挑担子上山时，你就趁着机会拿起扁担一通挥耍。村边讲故事的老爷爷给你讲过一只猴子耍棒子的故事，你便学那猴，整天拿着扁担当棒使。久而久之，你的扁担舞的有模有样，也算得上一手绝活。
role_feature_congenital_intro1422.en: Every time you carried a load up the mountain, you used the opportunity to wield a shoulder pole. An old man who told stories on the outskirts of the village told you a story about a monkey wielding a stick. You learned from the monkey and used the shoulder pole as a weapon every day. Over time, your shoulder pole dance became skillful and became quite a spectacle.

role_feature_congenital_intro1423.ch: 帮着父母劈柴烧饭久了，你也有了不少自己的心得。每次看到别人家的孩子笨拙地劈柴时，你便意气风发前去卖弄一番。时间长了，整个村子的孩子都开始找上门来。你只得苦眉皱脸地挨个儿去帮人家劈柴。
role_feature_congenital_intro1423.en: After helping your parents chop firewood and cook for a long time, you gained some insights. Every time you saw another child clumsily chopping wood, you would go and show off. Over time, all the children in the village started coming to you. You had to begrudgingly chop wood for each of them.

role_feature_congenital_intro1424.ch: 母亲教你做饭，你偏要拿着锅铲耍个不停。母亲训斥你，你便抱着锅铲满屋子跑。抓你不着，母亲去向父亲告状。父亲可不管三七二十一，抓起你就是一顿打，接着找个坏了的锅铲插在你背后，让你去向母亲负荆请罪。
role_feature_congenital_intro1424.en: Your mother taught you how to cook, but you insisted on playing with a spatula. When your mother scolded you, you ran around the house holding the spatula. When she couldn't catch you, she went to tell your father. Your father didn't hesitate and gave you a beating, then stuck a broken spatula behind you and made you apologize to your mother.

role_feature_congenital_intro1425.ch: 你一直都爱听说书人讲的关于英雄的故事。也常常幻想自己会像他一样行侠仗义，一杆枪打遍天下无敌手。后来你不知从何处顺来了根木棍，顶头绑上一根筷子，整天当做枪来使。
role_feature_congenital_intro1425.en: You have always loved listening to storytellers tell stories about heroes. You often fantasize about becoming a hero who fights for justice, wielding a gun that Defenseeats all enemies. Later on, you somehow got hold of a wooden stick and tied a chopstick to the top, pretending it was a gun and using it all day long.

role_feature_congenital_intro1426.ch: 比起拳脚功夫，你更擅长使用各种各样的武器对抗敌人，无论是哪一种武器你都能够轻松上手，而且进步飞快。
role_feature_congenital_intro1426.en: You prefer using weapons over hand-to-hand combat. No matter the type, you learned how to wield them quickly.

role_feature_congenital_intro1427.ch: 你对拳法与掌法的理解与常人有所不同，你不拘泥于传统的招式，更懂得在拳法与掌法之中取长补短。当你将这两种招式组合在一起时，会爆发出更大的威力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1427.en: You have a different understanding of fist and palm techniques. Rather than limiting yourself to traditional moves, you combine the moves from the two techniques to achieve a greater power.

role_feature_congenital_intro1428.ch: 你在学武的过程中偶然发现了枪法与指法的不同而又相通之处，将两者结合后的招式往往让敌人难以招架。以枪为指，也可以指为枪，打法多变，令人胆寒。
role_feature_congenital_intro1428.en: As you learned martial arts, you discovered the differences but also similarities between spear and finger techniques. Combining both would make it much harder for your enemies to defend. Your spear can be your finger, and the other way around, too.

role_feature_congenital_intro1429.ch: 你幼时曾见过两位传奇剑圣为了第一的名号同台展开激烈的较量。此时你便已经明白，剑将会是你一生的挚爱。
role_feature_congenital_intro1429.en: When you were little, you had the chance to witness a duel between two legendary swordmasters. It was at that moment that you realized swordsmanship would be your lifetime passion.

role_feature_congenital_intro1430.ch: 你自幼被狼养大，丛林生活让你的拳脚功夫和速度了得，不过你似乎不怎么招人喜欢。
role_feature_congenital_intro1430.en: You were raised by wolves. Growing up in the jungle has trained you to be physically quick and strong, but on the other hand, you are not very liked by others.

role_feature_congenital_intro1431.ch: 身为当代剑神之子，本身就有着不俗的剑法天赋。加上常年受到长辈的影响，你在剑法上的造诣比同龄人要高出许多。
role_feature_congenital_intro1431.en: As the son of a contemporary swordsman, you have an extraordinary talent for sword

role_feature_congenital_intro1432.ch: 身为当代刀神之子，本身就有着不俗的刀法天赋。加上常年受到长辈的影响，你在刀法上的造诣比同龄人要高出许多。
role_feature_congenital_intro1432.en: As the son of the contemporary God of Swords, you have exceptional talent in swordsmanship. Influenced by your elders, your skills in swordsmanship far surpass those of your peers.

role_feature_congenital_intro1433.ch: 身为当代枪神之子，本身就有着不俗的枪法天赋。加上常年受到长辈的影响，你在枪法上的造诣比同龄人要高出许多。
role_feature_congenital_intro1433.en: As the son of the contemporary God of Guns, you have remarkable talent in marksmanship. Influenced by your elders, your skills in marksmanship far surpass those of your peers.

role_feature_congenital_intro1434.ch: 你曾经是一位魔道大能生出的七子中的第七子，由于被几位兄长联合排挤、诬陷，导致这位魔道大能大怒，将你赶出家门，你从此与魔道势不两立。
role_feature_congenital_intro1434.en: You were once the seventh child born to a powerful sorcerer, but due to being ostracized and falsely accused by your older brothers, the sorcerer became enraged and expelled you from the family. Since then, you have had no association with sorcery.

role_feature_congenital_intro1435.ch: 你曾经是正道门派中资质上乘的精英弟子，由于你的师门逐步壮大，让其它正道门派都感到了威胁。最终你的师门在其它正道门派的围剿中覆灭，你苟活了下来，并与他们势不两立！
role_feature_congenital_intro1435.en: You were a talented disciple in a righteous sect. Your sect was growing quickly and becoming too powerful for the other sects. Out of jealousy, they joined forces and killed every one of your sect members but you. You survived and swore to take revenge.

role_feature_congenital_intro1501.ch: 你出生的时候，电闪雷鸣。似乎这已经预示了你对雷元素有着不一般的掌控力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1501.en: When you were born, there was lightning and thunder. It seems to have foretold your extraordinary control over the thunder element.

role_feature_congenital_intro1502.ch: 你出生的时候，山崩地裂。似乎这已经预示了你对土元素有着不一般的掌控力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1502.en: When you were born, there was a landslide. It seems to have foretold your extraordinary control over the earth element.

role_feature_congenital_intro1503.ch: 你出生的时候，村里到处起火。似乎这已经预示了你对火元素有着不一般的掌控力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1503.en: When you were born, fires broke out all over the village. It seems to have foretold your extraordinary control over the fire element.

role_feature_congenital_intro1504.ch: 你出生的时候，暴雨如注。似乎这已经预示了你对水元素有着不一般的掌控力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1504.en: When you were born, there was torrential rain. It seems to have foretold your extraordinary control over the water element.

role_feature_congenital_intro1505.ch: 你出生的时候，狂风大作。似乎这已经预示了你对风元素有着不一般的掌控力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1505.en: When you were born, strong winds blew. It seems to have foretold your extraordinary control over the wind element.

role_feature_congenital_intro1506.ch: 你出生的时候，花香四溢。似乎这已经预示了你对木元素有着不一般的掌控力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1506.en: When you were born, there was a fragrant breeze. It seems to have foretold your extraordinary control over the wood element.

role_feature_congenital_intro1507.ch: 这是一件很奇怪的事，你被雷击过好几次，但是居然除了头发没了，其它地方都完好无损。
role_feature_congenital_intro1507.en: It is quite strange that despite being struck by lightning several times, you only lost your hair and everything else remained unharmed.

role_feature_congenital_intro1508.ch: 你被火烧过好几次，可是一次都没有烧伤。而且似乎变得更强壮了。
role_feature_congenital_intro1508.en: You were trapped in fire multiple times but never burned. As a matter of fact, you became stronger afterwards every time.

role_feature_congenital_intro1509.ch: 你很小的时候就会游泳闭气，而且一憋就憋半天。
role_feature_congenital_intro1509.en: You were taught to hold your breath when learning to swim, and so you did. As it turned out, you could easily hold your breath for half a day.

role_feature_congenital_intro1510.ch: 你爷爷说祖屋风水不太好，屋后没有山。于是你干了一件惊人的事，你用三年挖土推了个小山。
role_feature_congenital_intro1510.en: Your grandpa believed your family house had bad feng shui because there were no mountains behind it. You surprised everyone by forming a hill with your bare hands in three years.

role_feature_congenital_intro1511.ch: 为了能让弟弟吃上各种水果，你在屋前屋后种植了大量的果树。而且每一棵都长势惊人。
role_feature_congenital_intro1511.en: Your little brother likes all kinds of fruits, so you planted many fruit trees around your house. And every one of them grew extremely well.

role_feature_congenital_intro1512.ch: 风一样的孩子，说的就是你，你跑起来的时候似乎与风一样飘逸。
role_feature_congenital_intro1512.en: You are like the wind, graceful and elegant when you run.

role_feature_congenital_intro1513.ch: 雷雨滂沱之时，邻居家的小孩尚在哭哭啼啼，你却对每一次雷鸣兴奋莫名。直到有一次你站在山巅之上，终于被一道雷霆打中——你的发型变成了爆炸头。
role_feature_congenital_intro1513.en: During a thunderstorm, while the neighboring children were crying, you were inexplicably excited by each thunderclap. Until one day, while standing on a mountain peak, you were finally struck by lightning, and your hairstyle turned into an explosion.

role_feature_congenital_intro1514.ch: 火石从来不是什么贵重之物，你却时刻把他带在身边。无聊的时候拿出来打一打，扑闪的火花便不断拨动着你的心弦。虽然父母一直告诫你说，小孩玩火会尿床，但你就是停不下来。
role_feature_congenital_intro1514.en: Firestones are not valuable, but you always carry one with you. When you're bored, you take it out and play with it, the spark flickering always resonates with your heart. Although your parents have always warned you that playing with fire would make you wet the bed, you just can't stop.

role_feature_congenital_intro1515.ch: 你是村里公认的善于水性。每逢六月旱热之际，你就叫上村里的会水的孩子，整天去溪水河流里玩水。时间长了，大家都认你当老大。
role_feature_congenital_intro1515.en: You are known in the village to be skilled in water activities. During the hot and dry season in June, you gather the children in the village and spend the day playing in the creek and rivers. Over time, everyone recognizes you as the leader.

role_feature_congenital_intro1516.ch: 如果不是因为家里有一件兽皮制成的衣物，扎实的紧，家里人也绝不会允许你一天到晚躺在地上滚来滚去。但是没办法，你就是那么喜欢脚下的土地，哪怕滚过一天浑身尘土，你也意犹未尽。
role_feature_congenital_intro1516.en: If it weren't for a piece of animal skin clothing in your family that tightly wraps around you, your family would never allow you to roll around on the ground all day. But you just love the land beneath your feet, even if you roll in the dust all day, you are never tired of it.

role_feature_congenital_intro1517.ch: 你对于玩闹之事一直不上心，因为家里有一堆盆植等着你去打理。每天在绿荫遮蔽下醒来是你最大的享受。有时候一两株盆植被小孩疯闹撞坏了，你就会恶狠狠地把那个孩子给踹出去。
role_feature_congenital_intro1517.en: You have never been interested in mischief because you have a bunch of potted plants in need of care at home. Waking up every day under the shade of greenery is your greatest joy. Sometimes when one or two of the potted plants were broken by mischievous children, you would kick the child out angrily.

role_feature_congenital_intro1518.ch: 小时候你的父亲亲自糊了一个纸风筝送给你，从那以后你的生活就离不开风筝相伴。每当放飞纸鸢之时，你的心也跟着飘到了九霄之外。有一个梦想你一直埋在心里，从未和任何人述说——你想像风筝一样翱翔于蓝天。
role_feature_congenital_intro1518.en: When you were young, your father personally made a paper kite for you. Since then, your life has been inseparable from kites. Every time you fly a kite, your heart soars with it into the sky. There is a dream buried in your heart that you have never shared with anyone - you want to soar in the blue sky like a kite.

role_feature_congenital_intro1519.ch: 风力与雷力是天道的力量，而你却自出生以来，就对这两种力量有不一般的领悟力。在这两种力量的影响下，你眉宇之间，多了点正气。
role_feature_congenital_intro1519.en: After the fusion of wind and fire, they devour everything. You can easily control these two terrifying forces. Under the influence of these forces, there is a hint of Righteousness between your brows.

role_feature_congenital_intro1520.ch: 土力与木力是地道的力量，而你却自出生以来，就对这两种力量有不一般的领悟力。在这两种力量的影响下，你眉宇之间，多了点正气。
role_feature_congenital_intro1520.en: After the fusion of earth and water, they flood everything. You can easily control these two terrifying forces. Under the influence of these forces, there is a hint of Wickedness between your brows.

role_feature_congenital_intro1521.ch: 当风与火结合后，就会吞噬一切，这两种恐怖的力量，你却可以轻松掌握。受这种力量的影响，你的眉宇之间，多了点魔气。
role_feature_congenital_intro1521.en: You have a certain level of control over the powers of thunder, earth, fire, water, wind, and wood, but your focus is often scattered and you have difficulty concentrating, which hinders your ability to use magical artifacts and elixirs effectively.

role_feature_congenital_intro1522.ch: 当土与水结合后，就会淹没一切，这两种恐怖的力量，你却可以轻松掌握。受这种力量的影响，你的眉宇之间，多了点魔气。
role_feature_congenital_intro1522.en: You possess single-minded determination, keen observation, and the ability to focus. This allows you to better use magical artifacts and elixirs. However, it is more difficult for you to control the six elemental powers of heaven and earth compared to others.

role_feature_congenital_intro1523.ch: 天有三才，曰风、雷、火；你天生对这三种能量有着超越凡人的掌控力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1523.en: Heaven holds three types of energy, namely wind, lightning, and fire. You were born with the ability to control them.

role_feature_congenital_intro1524.ch: 地有三才，曰土、木、水；你天生对这三种能量有着超越凡人的掌控力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1524.en: Earth holds three types of energy, namely earth, wood, and water. You were born with the ability to control them.

role_feature_congenital_intro1525.ch: 六根俱有，你对雷、土、火、水、风、土的力量有一定的掌控力，但是精神总是无法精中，对外物掌控力过于分散，无法更好的使用法宝、丹药。
role_feature_congenital_intro1525.en: When you were young, a passing "immortal" judged your six senses as impure and unsuitable for cultivation. However, the truth is not absolute. Not only are you skilled in using all six elemental powers in combat, but even your weakest elemental power surpasses the strongest of ordinary individuals.

role_feature_congenital_intro1526.ch: 天生心力专一，精神集中，观察入微，御物如神，可以更好的使用法宝、丹药。但是对于天地六灵根却比常人更难掌控。
role_feature_congenital_intro1526.en: You have always lived in the forest since you were young, and you have a mysterious affinity for trees. Perhaps because of the protection of nature, all creatures instinctively feel close to you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1527.ch: 你在幼年时就被一个路过自称“仙人”的家伙判断六根不净，不适合修炼。但事实无绝对，你不但能熟练的使用六种灵根进行战斗，就连你最弱的灵根都能碾压寻常人最强的灵根。
role_feature_congenital_intro1527.en: You naturally have a sensitivity to the earth element. Many times, you instinctively avoid landslides or earthquakes. You are kind-hearted, and everyone finds you approachable.

role_feature_congenital_intro1528.ch: 你自幼生活在水乡，对水有着莫名的亲和感，因为在水中待的时间很长，所以你比平常人白很多，使人看的喜欢。
role_feature_congenital_intro1528.en: Growing up in a canal town, you have an inexplicable affinity for water. Those long hours staying in water have made you paler than most.

role_feature_congenital_intro1529.ch: 你自幼生活在森林，对于树木有着莫名的亲和感，或许因为受到大自然的庇护，所有的生物都本能的对你感到亲切。
role_feature_congenital_intro1529.en: From a young age, you have been chasing the wind and freedom, enjoying the feeling of merging with the wind. Perhaps due to the protection of nature, all creatures instinctively feel close to you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1530.ch: 你的双亲都是火系强者。作为他们的后代，你的火灵根自然不会差到哪去。或许是受到灵根的影响，你的性格热情开朗，周围的人都对你有着不错的印象。
role_feature_congenital_intro1530.en: Both your parents are masters of fire. As their child, you were born with a strong Fire Root. Your personality is influenced by fire, too. Warm and cheerful, you leave a good impression on everyone around you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1531.ch: 你天生对土系敏感，多次凭感觉避免掉了山体滑坡、地震等天灾。你为人憨厚，大家都觉得你很亲切。
role_feature_congenital_intro1531.en: You have a natural affinity for the thunder element. Influenced by your elemental Spirit Roots, you act quickly and decisively, without hesitation. Everyone finds you very impressive.

role_feature_congenital_intro1532.ch: 你从小就喜欢追逐风与自由，享受着与风相互交融的感觉。或许因为受到大自然的庇护，所有的生物都本能的对你感到亲切。
role_feature_congenital_intro1532.en: When you were very young, you learned alchemy from a self-proclaimed "immortal." This fact is enough for you to boast about for a lifetime. However, because you were so young at the time, you have forgotten most of the alchemy Martial Arts, only retaining shallow knowledge.

role_feature_congenital_intro1533.ch: 你天生就有着强大的雷系。受到灵根你影响，你做事迅速果断，丝毫不拖泥带水，大家都觉得你很帅。
role_feature_congenital_intro1533.en: Although doodling and drawing may not be considered a skill, for some reason, you are good at drawing inexplicable symbols. Focusing on the task at hand has improved your control over drawing symbols and honed your spiritual consciousness.

role_feature_congenital_intro1601.ch: 你很小的时候曾经跟着一位仙人学过炼丹，这件事足够你吹上一辈子。但是因为那时实在太小，你对炼丹之法早就忘了大半，仅比外行多一些浅薄的认识。
role_feature_congenital_intro1601.en: Your family's inherited divination plate is your most valuable treasure. You have made a living out of it. "Divination encompasses heaven and earth; the symbols protect the four directions," is a phrase often on your lips. Although wealthy families may look down on your Geomancy skills, there are always people with extra money willing to hire you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1602.ch: 丹道是你祖传的技艺，但是你的家族被仇人屠尽，只有你一人侥幸逃了出来。后来你发了疯似的开始修习被列为丹道禁法的禁术，你梦想着等到时机成熟那天，你亲手将仇人折磨至死。
role_feature_congenital_intro1602.en: Alchemy is a craft passed down in your family. That is, until your family was slaughtered by its enemies. You were the only survivor. To avenge your loved ones, you began studying the forbidden alchemy method, awaiting your opportunity to make your enemies suffer.

role_feature_congenital_intro1603.ch: 你对炼丹似乎有着不同寻常的领悟力，有一次你炼出了一种奇怪的丹药，毒死了全村的猪。
role_feature_congenital_intro1603.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of alchemy. One time, you concocted a special elixir that unfortunately poisoned all the pigs in your village.

role_feature_congenital_intro1604.ch: 你对炼丹似乎有着不同寻常的领悟力，有一年村里发生瘟疫，你炼出一种避瘟丹，让全村人躲过了灾难。
role_feature_congenital_intro1604.en: You have an extraordinary understanding of alchemy. When a plague hit one year, you concocted an antidote that saved your entire village.

role_feature_congenital_intro1605.ch: 虽然乱涂乱画并不能算一种技能，但是不知为何的，你很擅长画一些同样莫名其妙的符咒。专注于手里的活让你对于画符的控制能力提升了不少，也锻炼了你的神识。
role_feature_congenital_intro1605.en: You seem to have an invisible third eye. Often, you can see things that others cannot. However, your physical body is relatively weak.

role_feature_congenital_intro1606.ch: 小时候你见到过一本书，里面讲的是移山填海之术。虽然书里的讲述略有夸大，但是仍旧帮助你增长了不少查探风水的基础知识。
role_feature_congenital_intro1606.en: When you were little, you read a book about moving mountains to fill up an ocean. The book was probably fictional, but it did help you learn the basics of feng shui.

role_feature_congenital_intro1607.ch: 家传的一个卦象盘是你身上最值钱的宝贝。一直以来你都以此为生。“卦生天地，象守四方”是你挂在嘴边的口头禅。虽然富家豪庭看不上你的勘舆之术，但总会一些手头有闲钱的人愿意请你做事。
role_feature_congenital_intro1607.en: You make a living as a blacksmith, working alongside your father. Living in a hot and dusty blacksmith shop all year round, your appearance, which does not pay attention to appearance, is not appreciated by others. However, your blacksmithing skills have been honed over the years and become increasingly exquisite.

role_feature_congenital_intro1608.ch: 你似乎长了一只无形的第三只眼睛，很多时候你可以看到常人看不到东西。但是你的身体却比较瘦弱。
role_feature_congenital_intro1608.en: You seem to have developed an invisible third eye, allowing you to see things that others cannot. However, your physical body is rather weak.

role_feature_congenital_intro1609.ch: 你随父亲打铁为生。常年于燥热的铁匠铺里生活，不注重打点的你外貌并不遭人喜欢。但是打铁的技艺却经年磨砺，愈发精湛。
role_feature_congenital_intro1609.en: You make a living as a blacksmith, working alongside your father. Living in the hot and dusty blacksmith shop all year round, you do not pay much attention to your appearance, which makes you unappealing to others. However, your blacksmithing skills have been honed over the years and have become increasingly exquisite.

role_feature_congenital_intro1610.ch: 你和其他人并没有什么不同，但是幼年的遭遇让你对丹器二事颇为上心。有事无事你都会收集一些相关的书籍翻阅，并且经常自己动手尝试。虽然成功率经常为零，但你却乐此不疲，夜以继日研习经典。
role_feature_congenital_intro1610.en: You are not much different from others, but your childhood experiences have made you more interested in alchemy and artifacts. You collect relevant books and often try your hand at various experiments. Although you often fail, you are tirelessly dedicated to studying the classics day and night.

role_feature_congenital_intro1611.ch: 你天生对药材的感觉就异于常人，你的体质能够自行从各类药材和丹药中自行分解其毒素。相对于普通人，你更懂得合理的利用药材炼制丹药。
role_feature_congenital_intro1611.en: Your natural sense of herbs is different than that of ordinary people. You have an innate ability to separate toxins from various herbs and elixirs, which allows you to more effectively refine herbs into elixirs.

role_feature_congenital_intro1701.ch: 傻人有傻福，古人说的一点不错。你的悟性极低，似乎对很多事都看得很淡，所以比常人活得更久，幸运之道力也似乎比较照顾你。
role_feature_congenital_intro1701.en: As they say, ignorance is bliss, and this proverb holds true for you. Your Insight is extremely low, and you seem to be indifferent to many things, which allows you to live longer than others and have good luck.

role_feature_congenital_intro1702.ch: 你的悟性可以用前无古人，后无来者来形容。这种绝顶的智力，让你心情难有波动。然而由于你过于聪慧，别人似乎不喜欢与你相处。
role_feature_congenital_intro1702.en: Your Insight can be described as unparalleled. This extraordinary intelligence allows you to have a calm mood. However, because you are too intelligent, people seem to dislike being around you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1703.ch: 你比一般人更聪明，但是你的头发很少。
role_feature_congenital_intro1703.en: You are smarter than the average person, but you have very little hair.

role_feature_congenital_intro1704.ch: 你的性格比较憨厚，反应也有点迟钝，不过大家都喜欢与你相处。
role_feature_congenital_intro1704.en: You have a simple and honest personality, and your reactions are a little slow, but everyone likes to be around you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1705.ch: 你的悟性非常低，可以说有点呆呆傻傻的，不过你的心情一直很好，根本不在意得失，外人也很难影响你那快乐的心境。
role_feature_congenital_intro1705.en: Your Insight is very low, to the point of being a bit foolish, but you are always in a good mood and are not concerned with gains and losses. It is difficult for outsiders to affect your happy state of mind.

role_feature_congenital_intro1706.ch: 你很聪明，善于计算，也善于与他人相处，就是经常会发生一些不在你计划内的事，你总是抱怨说运气不是特别好。
role_feature_congenital_intro1706.en: You are very intelligent, good at calculations, and have good interpersonal skills, but often encounter unexpected events outside of your plans, which makes you complain about your luck.

role_feature_congenital_intro1707.ch: 你悟性超凡，智慧过人。你对钱财却一直是一种不是特别在乎的态度。可能这也是你的智慧所在吧。
role_feature_congenital_intro1707.en: You have extraordinary Insight and wisdom. However, you have never cared much about money. Perhaps that is also where your wisdom lies.

role_feature_congenital_intro1708.ch: 你从小就是个闲不住的主儿，对周遭的事物好奇而敏感。经常跑出家门在外面一待就是一整天。如果不是父母托人四处寻你，你便是连家也顾不得回去。草生树长，风卷云舒，你都看的津津有味。
role_feature_congenital_intro1708.en: Since childhood, you have been curious and sensitive to things around you. You often run out of the house and spend the whole day outside. If not for your parents seeking help from others to find you, you wouldn't even bother going home. You take pleasure in observing the growth of grass and trees, and the changing patterns of the wind and clouds.

role_feature_congenital_intro1709.ch: 从小你就被父亲要求练习武技。日复一日艰难而枯燥的生活让你不像其他的孩子那样活泼好动，而是变得安静沉稳。坚持不断的体能训练以及武技磨炼也让你变得愈发强大。
role_feature_congenital_intro1709.en: Since childhood, your father has required you to practice Martial Arts. The daily arduous and monotonous training has made you less active and more calm than other children. Continuous physical training and Martial Arts practice have made you stronger.

role_feature_congenital_intro1710.ch: 你时常从旁边人家借阅书籍，新奇的知识总能让你整天整天地沉迷其中。虽然因为家徒四壁你也经常做些体力活，但常年缺乏食物滋补的身体终归是瘦弱无力。
role_feature_congenital_intro1710.en: You were always borrowing books from others and getting lost in all the new knowledge they provided you. Coming from a destitute household, you often had to engage in hard, laborious work, but the continued lack of nourishment eventually rendered your body quite weak.

role_feature_congenital_intro1711.ch: 出生于书香门第的你自幼熟读诗词文章，身边的大人们也都以把你当做自家孩子的榜样。常年知识的积累让你更容易领悟书中真谛，但是你那弱不禁风的身子骨着实难以舞刀弄枪。
role_feature_congenital_intro1711.en: Born into a scholarly family, you have been well-versed in poetry and literature since childhood, and the adults around you consider you as an example for their own children. The accumulated knowledge throughout the years makes it easier for you to comprehend the true essence of books, but your weak physique hinders you from wielding weapons effectively.

role_feature_congenital_intro1712.ch: 家境贫寒阻挡不住你天生爱好习武的热情。随手拾得树枝木棍都能在你手里舞的像模像样。后来不知道从哪里捡来一本武功秘籍，你便整天沉浸在自己的武术世界里不能自拔。
role_feature_congenital_intro1712.en: Despite growing up in a poor family, your passion for Martial Arts cannot be extinguished. Even a stick or a branch in your hand can be wielded skillfully. Later, you came across a secret Martial Arts manual by chance, and since then, you have been absorbed in the world of Martial Arts.

role_feature_congenital_intro1713.ch: 出生于武道世家的你最喜好拨弄兵器，习武强身。虽然家里也有不少书籍，你却丝毫不感兴趣。旁人虽嫌你斗大的字不认识一个，却害怕得罪了使得一手好兵器的你。一直对你敬奉有加。
role_feature_congenital_intro1713.en: You come from a family of Martial Arts and are most interested in manipulating weapons and practicing Martial Arts. Although your family has many books, you are not interested in them. Despite others complaining about your inability to read even big words, they are afraid of offending you, as you are skilled with weapons. People admire and respect you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1714.ch: 无论遇到什么样的挫折，你永远都会保持乐观向上的态度，虽然运气不是特别好，但是你健康的生活态度让你变得更加受欢迎。
role_feature_congenital_intro1714.en: No matter what setbacks you encounter, you always maintain a positive and optimistic attitude. Although luck is not particularly good for you, your healthy attitude towards life makes you more popular.

role_feature_congenital_intro1715.ch: 年幼的你家境贫寒，从记事起你便已经跟随父母在为了生计问题而努力挣扎。长时间的苦力活使得你能够比常人的内心更加坚强。
role_feature_congenital_intro1715.en: Born into a poor family, your parents have been struggling to make ends meet since you can remember. The many harsh years have made you more resilient than others.

role_feature_congenital_intro1716.ch: 周围的人对你的第一印象往往就是非常的坚挺，哪怕你已经精疲力竭了，在短暂的休息之后便能立刻恢复过来。
role_feature_congenital_intro1716.en: The first impression people have of you is that you are very strong. Even if you are exhausted, you quickly recover after a short rest.

role_feature_congenital_intro1717.ch: 你曾经得到过，一本叫做二泉映月的歌谱，你从中感受到了人生的辛酸，获得了智慧与许多感悟
role_feature_congenital_intro1717.en: You once obtained a music score called "Erquan Yingyue," which made you experience the bitterness of life and gain wisdom and insights.

role_feature_congenital_intro1718.ch: 你是当代魔道巨擘之.....孙，出生的时候，你的爷爷，就给了你一本适合自己的魔道功法。
role_feature_congenital_intro1718.en: You are the descendant of a contemporary magic sect. When you were born, your grandfather gave you a Martial Arts manual suitable for yourself.

role_feature_congenital_intro1719.ch: 你是当年领袖了正道势力抗争邪祟，并且守护了无数人的英雄传人。即便你从很小的时候就再也没见过他，但是他的英雄气概以及功法传承依然伴随你至今。
role_feature_congenital_intro1719.en: You are the descendant of the leader of a Righteous Path that fought against evil forces and protected countless people. Although you have not seen him since you were very young, his heroic spirit and Martial Arts heritage still accompany you to this day.

role_feature_congenital_intro1720.ch: 身为世上最神秘门派鬼谷的外门弟子，你的天赋异于常人！
role_feature_congenital_intro1720.en: As a disciple in Ghost Valley, the most mysterious sect in all the world, your talents exceed those of ordinary people!

role_feature_congenital_intro1801.ch: 你生下来的时候，口中衔着一块玉，仔细一看，居然是一只玉佩狐狸。长老说你还有前世有未了的缘分。
role_feature_congenital_intro1801.en: You were born holding a piece of jade in your mouth, and upon closer look, it was discovered to be a jade fox. The village elder said you must have had unfinished business in your past life.

role_feature_congenital_intro1802.ch: 你生下来的时候，身上长了很多鳞片，周边村里不知所以的人们有的以为你是妖物转世，有的说你是神仙下凡，究竟是什么原因呢？
role_feature_congenital_intro1802.en: You were born with many scales on your body, causing those in the village to think you a reincarnated monster, while others thought you a god descended from Heaven. But what was the actual reason?

role_feature_congenital_intro1803.ch: 你生下来的时候，手掌就特别厚，似乎像极了熊的手掌，而且力量奇大。这会是什么原因呢？
role_feature_congenital_intro1803.en: When you were born, your palms were unusually thick, resembling bear paws, and you possessed tremendous strength. What could be the reason for this?

role_feature_congenital_intro1901.ch: 据说你的祖上曾入仙界游历，并留下了一个物件。你稍长大后，族长传给了你。
role_feature_congenital_intro1901.en: It is said that your ancestors once traveled to the immortal world and left behind an object. When you grew up a little, the clan leader passed it on to you.

role_feature_congenital_intro1902.ch: 命运总是很奇特，你小时候玩泥巴，结果在泥巴里找到了一个带有神秘气息的物件，你不知道是什么，但是却一直小心亦亦的收在身上。
role_feature_congenital_intro1902.en: Fate is always peculiar. When you were playing with mud as a child, you found a mysterious object in the mud. You don't know what it is, but you have always kept it carefully.

role_feature_congenital_intro1903.ch: 因为你生在一个武学世家。据说你的祖上也曾入仙界。所以你从小习武，在你稍长大后，族长给了你一本家传武学。
role_feature_congenital_intro1903.en: Because you were born into a Martial Arts family, it is said that your ancestors also traveled to the immortal world. So from a young age, you have been practicing Martial Arts, and when you grew up a little, the clan leader gave you a Martial Arts manual passed down through the family.

role_feature_congenital_intro1904.ch: 你曾经在一棵大树下遇到一个白胡子老头，他说你根骨极佳，要收你为徒，可是你却不愿意，无奈下他给了你一本秘籍，说以后有缘再见，不过你一直看不懂。
role_feature_congenital_intro1904.en: Once, under a large tree, you encountered an old man with a white beard. He said that you had excellent aptitude and wanted to take you as his disciple. However, you refused, so he gave you a secret manual, saying that you would meet again by fate, but you have never been able to understand it.

role_feature_congenital_intro1905.ch: 家里有钱，其实也是个挺不错的事情。你早就向往修真飞升，听说修真界是使用灵石的，所以千方百计在黑市，化了几十块大金饼换了些闪闪发光的石头，也不知道是真是假。
role_feature_congenital_intro1905.en: Having wealth in the family is actually a good thing. You have always longed to cultivate and ascend in the world of cultivation, and you heard that spiritual stones are used in the cultivation world. So you have been trying various methods in the black market to exchange for some shiny stones, but you don't know if they are real or fake.

role_feature_congenital_intro1906.ch: 你少年时，掉进了一处洞天福地，无意中获得一堆看上去闪闪发光的宝石，但是一直不知道有什么用处。
role_feature_congenital_intro1906.en: When you were young, you fell into a hidden paradise by accident and obtained a pile of shiny gemstones that you didn't know how to use.

role_feature_congenital_intro1907.ch: 你少年时，掉进了一处洞天福地，无意中获得一堆看上去有点厉害的东西。至今你也没搞清到底有什么用。
role_feature_congenital_intro1907.en: When you were young, you fell into a hidden paradise by accident and obtained some impressive-looking items that you still don't know the use of.

role_feature_congenital_intro1908.ch: 你少年时，掉进了一处洞天福地，无意中获得一堆看上去特别厉害的东西。至今你也没搞清到底有什么用。
role_feature_congenital_intro1908.en: When you were young, you fell into a hidden paradise by accident and obtained some incredibly powerful items that you still don't know the use of.

role_feature_congenital_intro1909.ch: 在你很小的时候，家族就给你指定了一门亲事。而且还在你的脖子上系了一枚老旧的戒指。偶然的一天，你发现这个戒指里面居然可以装东西。
role_feature_congenital_intro1909.en: When you were very young, your family married you off and put an old ring around your neck. One day, you happened to discover that it was an interspatial ring that can store things.

role_feature_congenital_intro1910.ch: 曾经在梦中你见到一位与你同龄的仙子，她送了一枚戒指给你。醒来后，发现戒指真的就戴在手上。偶然的一天，你发现这个戒指里面可以装东西。
role_feature_congenital_intro1910.en: You were once given a ring by a fairy in a dream. When you awoke, that same ring was on your finger. One day, you happened to discover that it was an interspatial ring that can store things.

role_feature_congenital_intro1911.ch: 你的上一代人曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且富可敌国。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro1911.en: Your ancestors once traveled through the mythical realm of mountains and seas and were incredibly wealthy. You are now preparing to venture into the mythical realm of mountains and seas.

role_feature_congenital_intro1912.ch: 年幼的你抬头仰望天空的时候曾目睹大能御剑赶路，从此你爱上了剑，无法自拔。你不顾家人的反对每天都抱着一把木剑睡，尽管很难睡着。
role_feature_congenital_intro1912.en: When you were young, you saw an immortal zooming across the skies riding on a sword. You became obsessed with swords since then. You always hugged a wooden sword when you sleep, despite your family's rejection. It was also quite uncomfortable.

role_feature_congenital_intro1913.ch: 家境贫寒的你从小就没有鞋穿，但是也造就了你非凡的天赋，小时候无论是被狗撵还是被鸡赶，你总能逃出生天。
role_feature_congenital_intro1913.en: You had never been able to afford shoes as a kid, but somehow you still grew to be extraordinarily fleet-footed. You had always made it out in one piece when you were young, no matter it was rabid dogs or mad chickens.

role_feature_congenital_intro1914.ch: 小时候的你喜欢玩火，所以经常尿床，但是你惊奇的发现从此以后身体里多了水火这两种相反的能量在你的体内和谐共存。
role_feature_congenital_intro1914.en: You loved playing with fire as a kid, so you often wet your bed back then - just like the old saying goes. To your surprise, the opposing energies of Water and Fire has been running in harmony in your body since then.

role_feature_congenital_intro1915.ch: 你的家里很穷，啥也没有，只有四面墙，无意中却增加了你和大地厚重之力的亲密度。
role_feature_congenital_intro1915.en: Your family was so poor that it had nothing but four walls. That somehow matched the thick and sturdy characteristics of the element of earth, and boosted your affinity with it.

role_feature_congenital_intro1916.ch: 由于你家只有四面墙，你还经常凿，所以经常挨打，导致你受了一些内伤，但好在日后慢慢的变得皮糙肉厚。
role_feature_congenital_intro1916.en: Your family was so poor that it had nothing but four walls, and still you kept trying to dig through them to steal light from next door - and got beatings instead. You suffered some internal injuries, but also gradually became thick-skinned.

role_feature_congenital_intro2001.ch: 你就是天选之人，命中注定就是你！干什么事都那么顺利，简直不可思议。为什么你的运气这么好？
role_feature_congenital_intro2001.en: You are the chosen one, destined for greatness! Everything you do goes incredibly smoothly, it's almost unbelievable. Why is your luck so good?

role_feature_congenital_intro2002.ch: 你刚出生时异象频生，天地变色。幼时便气力过人，没人是你的对手，成年后更是力能扛鼎，倒拔垂柳。名声传遍四野八乡。
role_feature_congenital_intro2002.en: When you were born, there were omens in the sky and the earth. You had extraordinary strength even as a child, and no one could Defenseeat you. As you grew older, you became even stronger, capable of lifting heavy weights and performing incredible feats of strength. Your reputation spread far and wide.

role_feature_congenital_intro2003.ch: 没人知道你从哪里来，只是身体里流淌的金色血脉时刻提醒着你与常人不同。虽然经脉堵塞让你一度难以修炼，但在一位白衣神王的帮助下，你成功踏上求仙之路。
role_feature_congenital_intro2003.en: No one knows where you came from, but the golden blood flowing through your veins constantly reminds you that you are different from ordinary people. Although your meridians were blocked and you had difficulty cultivating your skills, with the help of a white-clothed god king, you successfully embarked on the path to immortality.

role_feature_congenital_intro2004.ch: 在杀神的培养之下，你从数名弟子里脱颖而出，走向杀戮之道的极致。可过于追求极致却又让你偏向一个极端。除了杀人，你什么也不会。杀神最终舍弃了你，任你一人流落四方。
role_feature_congenital_intro2004.en: Under the guidance of the Killing God, you stood out among several disciples and became the epitome of the path of slaughter. However, your pursuit of perfection made you lean towards an extreme. Besides killing, you knew nothing else. In the end, the Killing God abandoned you, leaving you to wander alone.

role_feature_congenital_intro2005.ch: 你是一个可怜的孩子，父母都在匪患中逝世，生存成了你最大的问题。那天，你从悬崖上跳了下去，决定离开这个世界。然而不知是幸运还是不幸，你被一个隐居谷底的魔修救了下来。从此你便拜他为师，跟着他学习六道轮回之法。决心杀尽世间该杀之人。
role_feature_congenital_intro2005.en: A pitiable child, your parents died by bandits, leaving you to fend for yourself. Deciding to leave this world, you flung yourself off a cliff, however, you were luckily (or unluckily) saved by a demonic immortal. From that point on, you became his disciple, and you began studying the Six Paths of Reincarnation, determined to kill those the world deemed should be killed.

role_feature_congenital_intro2006.ch: 祖辈传给你赶尸之法，你为了练习此法，经常夜里去掘人坟墓。有时候被人发现了便仓皇出逃。久而久之，很多人都知道有一个喜欢夜里掘墓的小孩子，他们开始口口相传关于你的恐怖故事。赶尸道童的称号便也举世皆知。
role_feature_congenital_intro2006.en: Your ancestors passed down the art of corpse rushing, and you often went to dig graves at night to practice this art. Sometimes you were discovered and had to flee. Over time, many people knew about a child who liked to dig graves at night, and they began to spread terrifying stories about you. The title of Grave-rushing Taoist became widely known.

role_feature_congenital_intro2007.ch: 前朝皇族出生的你似乎天生就背负着复兴家族的使命，但是在艰难的求生途中你逐渐忘记了自己的初心。家族祖传的功法让你有一定的自保能力，但是你每天都睡不安稳，似乎自己的仇人下一秒便会出现在眼前。
role_feature_congenital_intro2007.en: Born into a former imperial family, you seem to be destined to revive your family. But in the difficult journey of survival, you gradually forget your original purpose. The ancestral Martial Arts of your family give you some self-Defense abilities, but you cannot sleep peacefully, always fearing that your enemies will appear before you in the next second.

role_feature_congenital_intro2008.ch: 北域之灵，化生人形，世人称之为魔婴。据传魔婴所到之处，生人丧命，流血漂橹。幸好他们并不知道你就是那个传说中的魔婴。世人所传皆是谣言，你只知道因为小时候在世人前展现过神通，自己这一生已经难以平凡度过。
role_feature_congenital_intro2008.en: You are a Naissant Demon, the flesh-and-blood incarnation of a northern spirit. It is said that wherever a Naissant Demon goes, death and destruction follows. Though the rumors are false, you have still suffered a life of rigor ever since you displayed your innate powers in your childhood.

role_feature_congenital_intro2009.ch: 锦鲤跃龙门之日，便是你修成人身之时。天生的气运让你经常逢凶化吉。然而，若不是你生的俊美，惹人注意，可能祸事还不会太早降临到你的头上。一个仙家宗门看穿了你的出身，并且想要夺取你的肉身炼化金丹。
role_feature_congenital_intro2009.en: The day the carp leaped over the dragon gate was the day you received your human form. With your innate luck, you were always able to turn even the worst of situations in your favor. However, your beauty ultimately brought disaster upon you too soon. An immortal saw through you and now wants to use your flesh for alchemical purposes.

role_feature_congenital_intro2010.ch: 鸿鹄之士，皆是胸中满含豪情壮志之人。你从小就对自己要求颇为严格。十八般武艺样样精通，壮如蛮牛，势若猛虎。但凡挡在自己成仙路上的家伙，并不二话，动辄兵戎相向，毫不留情。论资质，你是真正的人中龙凤。
role_feature_congenital_intro2010.en: A man of great talent and ambition, you excelled in all eighteen Martial Arts from a young age. You were as strong as an ox and as fierce as a tiger. Anyone who stood in your way on the path to immortality would face your wrath without mercy. In terms of aptitude, you were a true dragon among men.

role_feature_congenital_intro2101.ch: 你对丹道的追求让你在很小的时候就有了很深的感悟。赤子丹心，炼化世间。只要是你经手炼制的丹药，哪怕成色再差，也从未失败过。
role_feature_congenital_intro2101.en: Your interest in alchemy helped you develop a deep sense of acumen even from a young age. You infused your passion into every elixir you ever made. Some might not look pretty, but none could argue they were not effective.

role_feature_congenital_intro2102.ch: 从小你就是师父的赚钱工具，但凡客人拿出任何器具，没有你炼不成的。后来被仇家追杀，逃命途中你与师父走散了。天涯沦落至今你也未寻见你师父。
role_feature_congenital_intro2102.en: Since childhood, you have been your master's money-making tool. There is no device that you cannot forge. However, you were chased by enemies and got separated from your master. Since then, you have been wandering and have yet to find your master.

role_feature_congenital_intro2103.ch: 由于从小热爱绘画，你走到哪儿画到哪儿。自从被一位符文师收为弟子之后，你画符的技艺一日千里。
role_feature_congenital_intro2103.en: Due to your love for painting from a young age, you would paint wherever you went. After becoming a disciple of a rune master, your skills in drawing runes improved rapidly.

role_feature_congenital_intro2104.ch: 祖传望龙气寻龙脉的本领到你这并没有失传，你凭借着这看家本领赚了很多钱，后来却疏忽大意被小偷偷光了。
role_feature_congenital_intro2104.en: Dragon veins are Feng Shui principles used to denote sources of great life energy and the paths by which they flow. You made a fortune helping many find their dragon veins, only to unfortunately lose it to a thief.

role_feature_congenital_intro2105.ch: 曾经在三清阁做过道童的你对道法的理解远超旁人。虽然后来因为种种原因你离开了三清阁，但是珍贵的修道的经历让你的成仙之路更加平坦。
role_feature_congenital_intro2105.en: As a former disciple in the pavilion of the three purities, you have a deeper understanding of Taoism than most. Though you left the pavilion, the cultivation experience you had there will ensure a smoother path in your ascension to an immortal.

role_feature_congenital_intro2106.ch: 你就是天选之人的孙子，命中注定！你的运气好到爆炸，常常经历危险的事，也能逢凶化吉。
role_feature_congenital_intro2106.en: You are the chosen one, destined! Your luck is off the charts, often encountering dangerous situations and turning them into fortunate ones.

role_feature_congenital_intro2107.ch: 从来没有人跟你说你的头发太长了，以至于当刺客前来暗杀你的时候，他发出的暗器被你的长头发挡了下来。
role_feature_congenital_intro2107.en: No one ever told you that your hair was too long—that is, until an assassin came to kill you, and your hair blocked his attack.

role_feature_congenital_intro2108.ch: 坊间传闻道，追风剑至，人头落地。这在你的手里并非虚言。一柄宝剑追风，让你成为了他人眼里死神的代名词。虽然嗜杀不应是习武之人的习惯。但你常常叹息世间奸恶阴险之徒实多，立下决心自己虽一人一剑，也定要见一个杀一个。
role_feature_congenital_intro2108.en: It is rumored that wherever the Wind-Chasing Sword goes, heads will roll. In your hands, this is not an empty statement. With a precious sword that can chase the wind, you have become synonymous with the Grim Reaper in the eyes of others. Although killing should not be the habit of a martial artist, you often lament that the world is filled with vile and treacherous individuals, and have made a vow to eliminate them one by one with your sword.

role_feature_congenital_intro2109.ch: 龙枪锋锐无坚不摧，一如使枪之徒肝胆赤心无恶不除。有人说这世道变了，变得小人横行奸臣当道。手握龙枪之人虽不屑流于世俗，但每当雷鸣龙降之刻，便是污浊洗净之时。
role_feature_congenital_intro2109.en: The Dragon Spear is sharp and unstoppable, just like its wielder, who is dedicated to eradicating evil. Some say the world has changed, filled with wicked people and corrupt officials. Those who wield the Dragon Spear, disdaining the mundane, strike without hesitation whenever the thunder roars, purifying the filth.

role_feature_congenital_intro2110.ch: 因为家乡被战乱摧毁，你跟着众人四处逃难。尚未脱离苦海，日渐猖獗的匪患又成了众人最大的担忧。在一次又一次的洗劫中，无数冤魂四散纷飞，可抢劫你们的匪徒却越来越少。同行的人纷纷望着你后背，满是敬畏与激动。魔刀之名，便也在亡命之徒的嘴里愈发恐怖。
role_feature_congenital_intro2110.en: Your hometown was destroyed by war, and you had to flee with others. As you escaped from the horrors of war, the growing bandit threat became everyone's biggest concern. In the repeated raids, countless vengeful spirits were scattered, yet the number of bandits dwindled. Your fellow travelers looked at you with a mix of awe and excitement. The name "Demon Sword" became increasingly terrifying in the mouths of desperados.

role_feature_congenital_intro2111.ch: 稳如石磐，重如泰山是外人对你最高的评价。一身了得的拳脚功夫哪怕在江湖上也足以名列前茅。但是正所谓过刚易折，也有不少人暗地里想要暗算你这尊不动明王。虽然迄今为止无人成功。但是未来的事情，谁又说得准呢。
role_feature_congenital_intro2111.en: Your hand-to-hand combat skills have earned you high respect and the nickname The Immovable. But, at the same time, being too strong makes enemies. Many have tried to best you. And though none have succeeded so far, you can never be sure about the future.

role_feature_congenital_intro2112.ch: 你被一位神秘老者抚养长大，从小便有数不尽的玩具。令你好奇的是，每天门外都有无数修仙者络绎不绝前来拜访老者，他们口尊老者为“神匠”，不远万里只为求取一件法宝。每至此时，老者就会从被你玩坏的玩具中随便挑一件扔过去。当你六岁时，老者将一块紫色巨石交给你，嘱托你日夜背负、勤加搓揉，随后便飘然离去。十年之后，你终于将这块巨石盘得圆润光滑，正当你欣喜之时，石头裂开了，一件自带器灵的法宝从中诞生。
role_feature_congenital_intro2112.en: You were raised by a mysterious old man, and not having enough toys was one of your last worries. What made you curious though, was how so many Cultivators would come over for him. They refer to him as the Divine Hand, and they would come from places afar just to beg for an Artifact. And when they do, the old man would just brush them off with one of your old and broken toys. When you turned six, the old man gave you a giant purple rock. He told you to keep it on you and clean it daily. Then, he left like the wind. Ten years have passed, and your unending polishing routine has finally elevated the rock into the shiniest mirror. You felt elated at the perfection, and that was when the rock cracked and an Artifact, bearing an Artifact Spirit, popped out.

role_feature_congenital_intro2113.ch: 出生之时，陨星降落，毁坏了整个村庄，幸存者离开村庄后重新生活，但在你12岁那年，陨石震荡，屠灭了除你以外的所有村民，你利用这些陨铁打造出了各种各样的道具，并且从中参悟了一些冶炼技巧，使你的炼器的理解比一般人要更加的深。
role_feature_congenital_intro2113.en: When you were born, a meteor shower fell, destroying the entire village. The survivors left the village and started a new life, but when you turned 12, another meteor shower struck and killed everyone in the village except you. You used the meteorites to create various tools and learned advanced metallurgical Martial Arts, deepening your Insight of forging compared to ordinary people.

role_feature_congenital_intro2114.ch: 你前世曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且成功的进入了天道筑基境界。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2114.en: In your previous life, you had traveled in the realm of immortals and successfully reached the realm of Foundation Establishment. Now, you are dressed up and ready to go back to the realm of Shanhai Bahuang.

role_feature_congenital_intro2115.ch: 你前世曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且成功的进入了一品金丹境界。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2115.en: In your previous life, you had traveled in the realm of immortals and successfully reached the realm of Golden Core. Now, you are dressed up and ready to go back to the realm of Shanhai Bahuang.

role_feature_congenital_intro2116.ch: 你前世曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且成功的进入了天道元婴境界。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2116.en: In your previous life, you had traveled in the realm of immortals and successfully reached the realm of Nascent Soul. Now, you are dressed up and ready to go back to the realm of Shanhai Bahuang.

role_feature_congenital_intro2201.ch: 九天雷动，念至电达。没有什么是一根粗壮的闪电炸裂不了的，如果有，就两根。
role_feature_congenital_intro2201.en: With thunder from the nine heavens, your thoughts can reach the ends of the earth. There is nothing that a powerful lightning cannot destroy, and if there is, then two lightning bolts will do the trick.

role_feature_congenital_intro2202.ch: 蚀体魔电，极紫雷光。时常沐浴在狂暴的闪电之中，你唯有感到神清气爽，力量无穷。
role_feature_congenital_intro2202.en: The deadly lightning can be a source of power. You often bath in the middle of lightning storms, and the only thing you feel is refreshed and powerful.

role_feature_congenital_intro2203.ch: 炽火元阳，焚尽苍生。这世间最可怖的武器，却是常伴你身的伙伴。但凡路见不平，必将炽火燎原，只留下一地碳化的死物四散纷飞尽。
role_feature_congenital_intro2203.en: Flames of heaven, burning of an all-devouring Yang. Arguably the most destructive weapon, fire is your friend. And you use it to burn anything unjust, leaving behind naught but ashes.

role_feature_congenital_intro2204.ch: 幽冥地火，阴煞噬人。经常夜里醒来，你发现自己是睡在一堆熄灭的火堆里。微凉的空气让你不太舒服。当地火从焦炭的内心燃起之时，哪怕是风也被驱逐远去。
role_feature_congenital_intro2204.en: Flames of nether, burning of an all-devouring Yin. Often you awake at night on a woodpile of dying flames, discomforted by the chilly night wind. Yet when the ghastly underground fires rise from the heart of the embers, even the nipping winds would not dare to approach.

role_feature_congenital_intro2205.ch: 瀚海百川，无尽波涛。气吞山河之势的大洪水是摧毁你家族的罪魁祸首，却又让你沐浴新生。当你发现自己能如臂使指驱使这般伟力，似乎再大的山川，也挡不住这无尽碧波。
role_feature_congenital_intro2205.en: A deadly flood destroyed your family but also made you born anew, especially after you realized you had the ability to control the power of floods. No mountains could withstand the all-devouring waves.

role_feature_congenital_intro2206.ch: 幽水恒流，水打石穿。你童年最大的爱好就是整天泡在水里，享受炎夏少有的清凉。但是有一天你飘着飘着就迷路了，当你发现你能在水下呼吸时，仿佛打开了了一扇新世界的大门。
role_feature_congenital_intro2206.en: Your favorite thing to do when you were young was bathe in the water and soak up the summer sun. One day, however, you floated farther and farther away until you became quite lost. It was at that moment that you discovered you could breathe underwater, which approached up a whole new world for you.

role_feature_congenital_intro2207.ch: 极北寒风，啸达天神。北域的风你见过不少，再大也不若眼前的这支。风啸犀利，断金裂铁。但是你毫发无损地走进它的中心，感觉自己仿佛和这狂风融为一体，不分彼此。
role_feature_congenital_intro2207.en: The chilling northernmost wind reaches heaven. You were no stranger to the northern wind, but none could compare with what howled before you. This raging wind was sharp enough to break any metal, but you walked into the center of it unscathed, you and the wind becoming one.

role_feature_congenital_intro2208.ch: 旷野之风，悲凉若绝。当你从深秋的风里触摸到悲意时，这丝丝风之灵便潜入你的体内，你目之所及，风流不息。
role_feature_congenital_intro2208.en: The wind in the wild howled the deepest sorrow. As you touched the sadness in the wind of late autumn, the wind spirit sneaked into your body. From then on, wind blew wherever you laid your eyes on.

role_feature_congenital_intro2209.ch: 皇土仁厚，布达四极。云游天下之际，脚下的大地让你不再居无定所。天为被，地为床。你浑身都散发出后煌之土的气息，宽广敦厚，重逾千斤。
role_feature_congenital_intro2209.en: Where is earth, there is home. When you traverse the world, the sky is your blanket and the earth is your bed. As the earth beneath you grows heavier, you reach closer to your destination.

role_feature_congenital_intro2210.ch: 尘土蕴气，灵涤八方。长年行走在土地上，你不再认为土卑无灵。夜深人静之时，你睡在地上，感受到自己身下的大地安静而厚重。睁开双眼，你已深埋地下，却呼吸如常。
role_feature_congenital_intro2210.en: Dust holds the essence, and your spirit purifies all directions. After years of walking on the earth, you no longer think of it as lowly and lifeless. In the quiet of the night, you sleep on the ground, feeling the quiet and solid earth beneath you. When you open your eyes, you find yourself buried deep underground, yet still able to breathe normally.

role_feature_congenital_intro2211.ch: 绝生木灵，森罗万象。你爱上了那片森林，可让你苦恼的是，只要你触摸过的树，总有那么几颗会加速枯萎。久而久之，整片古树林再无活木，你也失去了那片森林。
role_feature_congenital_intro2211.en: Being a master of wood spirits, you have seen all the wonders of nature. You fell in love with a forest, but what troubles you is that every tree you touch eventually withers. Over time, the entire ancient forest became lifeless, and you lost that beloved forest.

role_feature_congenital_intro2212.ch: 古藤有道，枯木逢春。在你出生前，你的家乡以种田为生。而你出生后，你的家乡开始卖起了木材。无它，灵木疯长，伐之不绝。
role_feature_congenital_intro2212.en: Ancient trees wither but never die. When spring comes, they grow again. Before you were born, your hometown relied on farming for a living. After you were born, your hometown began to sell timber. The reason was simple—the spiritual trees grew endlessly.

role_feature_congenital_intro2301.ch: 在过马路的时候，你遭遇车祸不幸丧生，灵魂却莫名其妙附身到这个世界一个孩童的身上。你在与村里人相处的过程中时时展露不凡，并且因为一些奇怪的口头禅被人熟知。
role_feature_congenital_intro2301.en: Unfortunately, you died in a car accident while crossing the road but inexplicably your soul possessed the body of a child in this world. Through interactions with the people in the village, you occasionally display extraordinary abilities, and your unique catchphrases make you recognizable to others.

role_feature_congenital_intro2401.ch: 从小你就出生在一个世外桃源，青山绿水相伴为乐。每当你在水里嬉戏或是奔走于林木之间时，体内总有隐隐约约的悸动感。谁也不知道这究竟意味着什么。
role_feature_congenital_intro2401.en: Since childhood, you were born in a secluded paradise with green mountains and clear waters. Whenever you frolic in the water or run among the trees, there is always a faint pulsation within you. Nobody knows what it signifies.

role_feature_congenital_intro2402.ch: 和别人不一样的是，你最喜欢暴风雨天气，狂风卷着雨点打在你身上的时候，你感到由衷的舒适。但你又很害怕雷雨天气，因为轰鸣的雷声总是能吓得你肝胆俱颤。
role_feature_congenital_intro2402.en: Unlike others, you enjoy stormy weather. When strong winds and raindrops hit you, you feel a genuine sense of comfort. However, you are terrified of thunderstorms, as the booming thunder always scares you.

role_feature_congenital_intro2403.ch: 坐在篝火旁时，你就哪儿也不想去。温热的火焰总能让你通体舒泰。当一阵疾风袭来。风助火势让篝火跃出火舌，你的身体不由自主颤动了起来，脑海里不由得浮现出风火燎原之势。
role_feature_congenital_intro2403.en: Sitting beside a bonfire, you have no desire to go anywhere else. The warm flames make you feel at ease throughout your body. When a gust of wind blows, fueling the fire, the flames leap and your body involuntarily trembles, bringing to mind scenes of a raging blaze.

role_feature_congenital_intro2404.ch: 你从小就对爆竹炮仗之类的小玩意十分感兴趣，在小孩子团队里，你是眼里容不得沙子的孩子王。火爆的脾气让你做什么都雷厉风行，长期坚持锻炼也让你身体愈加强壮。
role_feature_congenital_intro2404.en: Since childhood, you have been fascinated by firecrackers and fireworks. Among the children in the neighborhood, you are the one with a fiery temper, always acting quickly. The perseverance gained through long-term training has made your body stronger and stronger.

role_feature_congenital_intro2405.ch: 在村子里，你是最敦厚老实的那个，这使得别人总是对你指手画脚，呼来唤去。但你不管做什么事都是专心致志，细致入微。这让你逐渐变得胆大心细，也越来越受到大家的尊重。
role_feature_congenital_intro2405.en: In the village, you are known as the most honest and kind-hearted person, which causes others to boss you around. However, no matter what you do, you always focus and pay attention to details. As a result, you gradually become more brave and meticulous and gain respect from others.

role_feature_congenital_intro2406.ch: 由于打翻了琉璃盏，你被一家无良教派赶出山门。你愤愤不平使出神通杀了教派治下村庄的几个凡人，并且在教派的追杀令下潜逃至今。
role_feature_congenital_intro2406.en: Due to accidentally breaking a glass lamp, you were expelled by an unscrupulous sect. Filled with Righteous Path anger, you used your extraordinary powers to kill several ordinary villagers under the sect's control and have been on the run from the sect ever since.

role_feature_congenital_intro2407.ch: 你是一个书呆子，平生最大的爱好就是品书论道。虽然多年的积累让你在修仙感悟上有了不少心得，但是长时间的缺乏锻炼也让你体质较弱。
role_feature_congenital_intro2407.en: You are a bookworm, and your greatest passion is discussing books. Although years of accumulation have given you insights into cultivating immortality, the lack of physical training has made your constitution weaker.

role_feature_congenital_intro2408.ch: 出生时浮现出参天古树，你一出生皮肤宛如古树皮一般，处处皱褶，因此你被人各种嫌弃，但是树皮一般的皮肤也给了你不俗的防御力，木灵力和一颗善良的心。
role_feature_congenital_intro2408.en: An ancient tree appeared when you were born, and then your skin turned wrinkled like the bark of the ancient tree, turning people away from you. However, this skin gave you a high level of defense, an affinity with wood, and a kind heart.

role_feature_congenital_intro2409.ch: 你有着龙的血脉，天生力气和耐打能力就此一般人强，而且似乎你比别人幸运一些。
role_feature_congenital_intro2409.en: You possess the bloodline of a dragon, giving you natural strength and resilience beyond ordinary people. It seems that you are also luckier than others.

role_feature_congenital_intro2410.ch: 你有着凤的血脉，天生力量就比一般人要强大，而且似乎你要比别人幸运得多。
role_feature_congenital_intro2410.en: You possess the bloodline of a phoenix, giving you natural strength greater than ordinary people. It also seems that you are luckier than others.

role_feature_congenital_intro2411.ch: 你有着虎的血脉，天生力气就比一般人要强大很多，而且似乎你比别人更擅长搏杀。
role_feature_congenital_intro2411.en: You possess the bloodline of a tiger, giving you much stronger strength than ordinary people and a talent for combat.

role_feature_congenital_intro2412.ch: 你有着象的血脉，天生的体魄和抗击打能力要比一般人强大很多，而且似乎你比别人幸运一些。
role_feature_congenital_intro2412.en: You possess the bloodline of an elephant, giving you a powerful physique and an ability to withstand attacks much better than ordinary people. It also seems that you are slightly luckier than others.

role_feature_congenital_intro2413.ch: 你小的时候，遇到一个老乞丐，老乞丐对你说，他与你有缘送了你一本书让你修炼，可是你练了好几年也只是变得好看一点！
role_feature_congenital_intro2413.en: When you were young, you met an old beggar who told you that you were destined for greatness and gave you a book to cultivate. However, after several years of practice, you only became slightly more attractive.

role_feature_congenital_intro2414.ch: 在有龙脉之地会受天地气运护体，龙脉护体作为一国之君或宗门之首，麾下子民，弟子，都会收到庇护，受到龙神庇佑。
role_feature_congenital_intro2414.en: Where the dragon veins lie, good fortune follows. Those who rule an empire or are the leaders of sects are all blessed by the mighty dragon, and so are the people under them.

role_feature_congenital_intro2415.ch: 天地精华于一身的你，资质上就要更胜普通人一筹，容颜更是迷倒世间芳华。
role_feature_congenital_intro2415.en: With the essence of heaven and earth flowing within you, your talent surpasses ordinary people, and your beauty is captivating.

role_feature_congenital_intro2416.ch: 你的上一代人曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且帮助愚公移平了太行山与王屋山。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2416.en: Your previous generation had traveled through the vast world of immortals and helped Yuguang move the Taihang Mountains and Wangwu Mountains. Now you are dressed up and ready to embark on another journey.

role_feature_congenital_intro2417.ch: 你的上一代人曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且帮助后羿打败了三足乌。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2417.en: Your previous generation had traveled through the vast world of immortals and helped Hou Yi Defenseeat the Three-Legged Crow. Now you are dressed up and ready to embark on another journey.

role_feature_congenital_intro2418.ch: 你的上一代人曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且帮助精卫填平了东海。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2418.en: Your previous generation had traveled through the vast world of immortals and helped Jingwei fill in the East Sea. Now you are dressed up and ready to embark on another journey.

role_feature_congenital_intro2419.ch: 你的上一代人曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且帮助燧人氏取得了火种。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2419.en: Your previous generation had traveled through the vast world of immortals and helped Suiren obtain the spark of fire. Now you are dressed up and ready to embark on another journey.

role_feature_congenital_intro2420.ch: 你的上一代人曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且与夸父有过一番交集。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2420.en: Your previous generation had traveled through the vast world of immortals and had some interaction with Kuafu. Now you are dressed up and ready to embark on another journey.

role_feature_congenital_intro2421.ch: 你的上一代人曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且打败了刑天残魂。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2421.en: Your previous generation had traveled through the vast world of immortals and Defenseeated the remnants of Xingtian's soul. Now you are dressed up and ready to embark on another journey.

role_feature_congenital_intro2422.ch: 你的上一代人曾经在山海八荒界游历过，并且四面树敌。你盛装待发，准备再次前往山海八荒界。
role_feature_congenital_intro2422.en: Your previous generation had traveled through the vast world of immortals and faced enemies from all sides. Now you are dressed up and ready to embark on another journey.

role_feature_congenital_intro2423.ch: 你年少之时，曾经一人打死了一只巨虎，你的拳头力量奇大，拳风之中还隐隐带有火光一般，真是惊人。
role_feature_congenital_intro2423.en: Your fists have enormous power. When you throw a punch, the air trembles with sparks. You once killed a tiger with your bare hands when you were young.

role_feature_congenital_intro2424.ch: 你在少年之时，发现头上经常会凝聚出火、土、雷一样的三种虚幻的花朵，虽然你也不知道怎么回事，但是随着你的成长，你发现你可以以心力激发这三种力量。
role_feature_congenital_intro2424.en: When you were young, three flowers in the shapes of fire, earth, and lightning would grow atop you head. You had no idea what they meant. As you grew older, you realized you had the ability to control these three powers.

role_feature_congenital_intro2425.ch: 据说你出生之时，屋前屋后奇花盛开，香气四溢，桃李果实一晚便结满树头。有人说你身上带有上古建木的灵力。
role_feature_congenital_intro2425.en: It is said that when you were born, there were beautiful flowers blooming in front and behind your house, with fragrance filling the air, and peach and plum trees bearing fruits overnight. Some say that you possess the spiritual power of ancient trees.

role_feature_congenital_intro2426.ch: 经过在山海八荒界的一番历练，你似乎已经被那个神秘的门派认可了。虽然你从来也没不知道这个门派在哪里。
role_feature_congenital_intro2426.en: Your hardships paid off as you were finally recognized by Ghost Valley, the most mysterious sect in all the world. Though you never really knew where it was located.

role_feature_congenital_intro2501.ch: 翩翩君子，温润如玉；守拙归朴，抱元求真。你是所有人心里最完美的样子，也是许多人暗地里幻想的对象。每日观文于书阁之中，你的气质无以伦比，身子骨却有些羸弱。
role_feature_congenital_intro2501.en: You are an elegant and gentle gentleman, warm and jade-like. You adhere to simplicity and seek truth. You are the embodiment of perfection in everyone's heart and the object of many people's fantasies. You spend your days reading in the study, and your temperament is unparalleled, but your physique is somewhat weak.

role_feature_congenital_intro2502.ch: 翩翩君子，温润如玉；家有父，人称君父。作为国民岳父的你虽然没有孩子那么年轻俊美，却也是身姿挺拔，气质不凡。宽大而健壮的身材足以让你胜任家里的苦力活。
role_feature_congenital_intro2502.en: You are a gentleman, warm and jade-like, and you are known as a father to the people. As the nation's father-in-law, you may not be as young and handsome as your children, but you have a tall and extraordinary stature. Your broad and robust figure allows you to handle the strenuous tasks at home.

role_feature_congenital_intro2503.ch: 在没有另一半的世界里，你过得很快乐。这也吸引着你身边的落魄之人向你投递出热情的眼神。
role_feature_congenital_intro2503.en: Staying single makes you happy. Your positive attitude has also earned you a good reputation.

role_feature_congenital_intro2504.ch: 你曾大声暴喝吓死了一头驴。这也让你的异性缘并不太好，毕竟没有谁愿意整天和一个扩音喇叭待在一起。但是十里八乡皆知你的威名，大家都有一个共识，惹谁也不能惹你，否则耳朵就得遭殃。
role_feature_congenital_intro2504.en: You once shouted loudly and scared a donkey to death. This also affects your popularity with the opposite sex, as no one wants to be around someone with a loudspeaker all the time. But your reputation is known far and wide, and everyone agrees that no one should provoke you, or else their ears will suffer.

role_feature_congenital_intro2601.ch: 你从小就是一个左撇子，但是你并没有表现得太与众不同。母亲跟你说左撇子比常人更聪明，你觉得确实是这么一回事。但是似乎其他人并不这么认为。
role_feature_congenital_intro2601.en: You have been a left-handed person since childhood, but you haven't shown too much difference from others. Your mother told you that left-handed people are smarter than normal people, and you feel that it is indeed the case. But it seems that others don't think so.

role_feature_congenital_intro2602.ch: 你喜欢云游天下，这帮你积累了大量的人脉；而你那因为见多识广而磨砺出来的一种出尘的气质，常常让别人喜欢与你多聊几句。
role_feature_congenital_intro2602.en: You enjoy traveling around the world, which has helped you accumulate a large network of people. Your extraordinary temperament, honed from seeing and Insight the world, often makes others enjoy chatting with you.

role_feature_congenital_intro2603.ch: 原本大家以为你是天命者的曾孙，运气一定很好，但倒霉的事情却常常发生在你身上…
role_feature_congenital_intro2603.en: Originally, everyone thought that you were the great-grandson of the chosen one, and your luck must be very good, but unfortunate things often happen to you...

role_feature_congenital_intro2604.ch: 副正道根，时不时会有正气溢出，让人心旷神怡，受正道宗门之喜爱，魔道中人之厌恶。行走修仙界，要多多小心魔道中人。
role_feature_congenital_intro2604.en: As a half-Righteous Path practitioner, positive energy occasionally overflows from you, bringing joy to the Righteous Path sects and disgust to the Demonic Path. When walking in the cultivation world, you must be careful of the Demonic Path practitioners.

role_feature_congenital_intro2605.ch: 为人邪恶，常常伴有魔气缠身，让人心生畏惧，受魔道中人之喜欢，正道宗门之厌恶。行走修仙界，要多多小心正道宗门。
role_feature_congenital_intro2605.en: As an evil person, you are often surrounded by Demonic Path energy, which makes people fearful. You are liked by the Demonic Path practitioners but disliked by the Righteous Path sects. When walking in the cultivation world, you must be careful of the Righteous Path sects.

role_feature_congenital_intro2708.ch: 在推销自己的东西时，你总是比常人更加的积极和主动，懂得让别人理解自己的产品优势，往往能让自己的商品获得更多的利润。
role_feature_congenital_intro2708.en: When selling your own products, you are always more proactive and enthusiastic than others. You know how to make others understand the advantages of your products, which often allows you to gain more profit.

role_feature_congenital_intro2709.ch: 在做买卖的过程中，你擅长利用自己的阅历与头脑，是自己的收益能够达到最大化。同时你只看重利益的嘴脸让周围的人都对你产生厌恶感。
role_feature_congenital_intro2709.en: In the process of doing business, you are good at using your experience and intelligence to maximize your profits. However, your focus solely on profit makes people around you have a sense of disgust.

role_feature_congenital_intro2801.ch: 你非常幸运，因为你拥有一个对你至死不渝的青梅竹马。你们发誓不管遇到多大的磨难都绝不会抛弃对方。你们一起经历过生死，一起享受过富贵，今后也将并肩继续前行。
role_feature_congenital_intro2801.en: You are very lucky because you have a childhood sweetheart who is unwaveringly loyal to you. You have sworn to never abandon each other no matter how great the difficulties are. You have experienced life and death together, enjoyed wealth together, and will continue to move forward side by side in the future.

role_feature_congenital_intro2802.ch: 不知道从什么时候开始，你的梦中偶尔会闯入一只白鹤来为你讲解功法。你不知道这只白鹤的背后到底是什么人，但你非常肯定他就是你的授业恩师。
role_feature_congenital_intro2802.en: From an unknown time, a white crane occasionally appears in your dreams to teach you Martial Arts. You don't know who is behind this white crane, but you are certain that it is your mentor.

role_feature_congenital_intro2803.ch: 小时候，你因为贪玩在山中迷了路。天色渐暗，无助的你呆呆望天，突然感到肩头一阵刺痛，原来是一只毛虫掉在你的身上并咬了你一口。你大惊失色，原以为自己命不久矣，没想到身体内似乎多了一种奇特气息。
role_feature_congenital_intro2803.en: You got lost in the mountains when you were a child because you were too playful. The sky grew dark and you were looking at the sky helplessly when you suddenly felt a tingling pain in your shoulder. A caterpillar had fallen on your body and bitten you. You were shocked, and thought you were going to die soon, but unexpectedly, your body seemed to have gained a peculiar Breath.

role_feature_congenital_intro2804.ch: 从小到大，你总是会做一个奇怪的梦，梦中一团模糊的黑影隐约发出奇怪的呓语，饿…好饿！直到你开灵后黑影从梦中走出…
role_feature_congenital_intro2804.en: Since childhood, you've been haunted by a strange dream where a hazy shadow always mumbles, "I'm... so hungry!" You know what it means only after you got an enlightenment and saw the shadow stepped out of your dream...

role_feature_congenital_intro2805.ch: 你的双眼天生神异，可以看见阴魂，初时不觉，只因阴魂恍若无存，看得见却无法交流。直到有一天，一个阴魂和你对上了眼神：这位道友…
role_feature_congenital_intro2805.en: Your eyes were born with a mystical power to see spirits. At first, you didn't notice the spirits since they seemed visible yet beyond communication. Then one day, a spirit's gaze met yours, "Hi there, fellow cultivator..."

role_feature_congenital_intro2806.ch: 某日午未之交，你体内清气激荡聚成灵力，萃结光莲。此后，光莲与你共生成长，结出灵气氤氲的莲子，蔚为奇观。
role_feature_congenital_intro2806.en: One afternoon, mystic energy surged and swirled within your body, crystallizing into a Radiant Lotus. Since then, the Radiant Lotus has grown as one with you, producing seeds shrouded in spiritual Qi—a sight of remarkable wonder.

role_feature_congenital_intro9300201.ch: 你从小就觉得精神世界中有高山大海，有珍奇异兽，有一切的一切。所谓雕梁画栋抑或萧然漏室对于你来说根本没区别。你的需要，不假外求。
role_feature_congenital_intro9300201.en: You always feel a wonderful world in your mind. Inside your miniatured cosmos, you can find everything from sublime sceneries to marvelous creatures. You are a solitary, cheerful skylark soaring under your own heaven, freed from mundane satisfactions.

role_feature_congenital_intro9300202.ch: 你从小就备受瞩目，外界的几名大宗长老数度来到你家，想将你收为亲传弟子，还曾有神秘组织邀你加盟。不知这到底是什么原因，然而你在旁人眼中就是如此一个出类拔萃的人物。
role_feature_congenital_intro9300202.en: You have always been a brilliant center of attention. When you were a kid, elders from famous sects came to visit you and requested you to be their true disciples, and you even received an invitation from a secret order. You don't know why you are so favored, but in other people's eyes, you are like a star with an unmistakable shine.

role_feature_congenital_intro9300203.ch: 你曾在旷野之中追逐一颗闪耀紫光的彗星，然则你追上之后彗星已在天空燃尽化作漫天明霞。你很失望，但自此之后，你紫气绕身，恍如华衣。还因此得了个诨号，天韵童儿。
role_feature_congenital_intro9300203.en: You chased a violet comet in a vast wilderness when you were a kid. You finally ran to it, only to see the strange visitor had split into dazzling beams. The fact saddened you, but from then, a purple aura enveloped you like a fine robe and brought you the nickname of Violet Kid.

role_feature_congenital_intro9300204.ch: 自你降生之日起，就有一件素衣包裹着。你不明白这是为什么，但每当你拿起这件衣服细细端详的时候，你就会生出一股使命感。将来，你要赐予旁人一样很重要的东西，可那是什么呢？
role_feature_congenital_intro9300204.en: You were clad in a white robe when you were born. You don't know why you received it, but a feeling of something great comes to you when you look at the robe. Maybe in the future, you will bestow another person a significant gift... But what is it?

role_feature_congenital_intro9300205.ch: 自打记事以来，你便一直觉得自己不属于八荒这个地方。甚至，你觉得自己只是活在一场梦中，而周围一切都是不真实的。你很想将使你生出这种错觉的原因找出来。
role_feature_congenital_intro9300205.en: You are always carefree, but the reason behind your nonchalance is that you feel you are but an outsider to this world. Sometimes you even feel like you're living in an ethereal dream, and you hope to find out the truth about the strange feeling one day.
